chapter.title: Places
subtitle: Sixteen real places in this world, with the two numbers that find them.
Nothing here is on the way to anything. That is the point.

hover: Every place below is a real place.
Dungeon stone. Older than the valley.
Nella keeps one on the boat.
The savanna village builds in this.
Somebody's way out, half fallen down.
The deepest thing on this board.

quests.title: Pack a Bag Before You Leave
quests.subtitle: Torches first. The rest is optional.
description: Everywhere on this board is dark and most of it is underground. Carry &a32 Torches&r and food you can eat walking.
Each place below is real, and its two numbers are on the card.

quests.title: Find the Small Dungeon West of Home
quests.subtitle: Four hundred blocks west, then down.
description: Head west from the farm hearth to &b-424, 8&r. The stair is under the grass and the mob room is two floors below it.
&cSpawners keep working while you loot.&r Cage first, chests after.

quests.title: Get Into the Oak Mineshaft
quests.subtitle: Rails go somewhere. Follow them.
description: Walk to &b-312, 248&r and dig until you hit timber. The rails run a long way and the cobweb rooms hold the chests.
A sword cuts &aCobweb&r into string. Carry the string home.

quests.title: Find the House With No Front Door
quests.subtitle: Somebody built it under a field.
description: Dig at &b-344, 120&r. The roof is a patch of ordinary grass and the rooms under it are furnished, lit and still stocked.
Take the bed. Whoever laid it is not coming back for it.

quests.title: Dig Out the Sky Stone Crater
quests.subtitle: 110 blocks east of the farm hearth.
description: Walk east from the hearth to &b-216, 72&r and dig the dark stone. The chest under the crater holds an &aInscriber Press&r.
The presses belong to the &6Storage Network&r chapter.

quests.title: Dive the Shipwreck Off the North Shore
quests.subtitle: Two chests: one in the hold, one on deck.
description: Nella: "A wreck is a boat that stopped early. Take the map out of it and leave the planks alone."
Swim to &b-120, 376&r. The hold holds the treasure map, the deck the food.

quests.title: Dig Up the Buried Treasure
quests.subtitle: The X is under the sand, not on it.
description: Follow the wreck's map to &b-472, 248&r and dig straight down under the cross until the chest turns up.
The &aHeart of the Sea&r comes out of nowhere else in this world.

quests.title: Swim the Cold Ocean Ruin
quests.subtitle: Half of it is buried in gravel.
description: Take a boat to &b72, 184&r and dive. The ruin is broken stone brick on the sea floor with two or three chests in it.
Bring a &aBucket&r. An air pocket beats surfacing.

quests.title: Clear the Illager Camp
quests.subtitle: Tents, a cage, and a lot of crossbows.
description: Go to &b-520, 216&r. &cThe towers shoot down into the camp&r, so take the towers first and the tents afterwards.
Whatever is in the cage in the middle is alive.

quests.title: Find the Bathhouse in the Hills
quests.subtitle: Not the one Halden is fitting out in town.
description: Walk to &b-600, 24&r. Stone rooms over a hot pool, a floor above the water and a colder one under it.
The town's bathhouse is Act IV, step 72a. This one is older.

quests.title: Walk Into the Plague Asylum
quests.subtitle: Long corridors. Short sightlines.
description: It stands at &b168, 24&r, east across the water. &cThe corridors refill behind you&r, so work one wing at a time.
The upper floor is the one worth the walk.

quests.title: Trade in the Savanna Village
quests.subtitle: Half a kilometre south of the square.
description: Head south to &b-328, -504&r. Acacia houses, a well in the middle, and villagers who buy wheat for &aEmeralds&r.
Oda pays in scrip. They pay in emeralds. Take both.

quests.title: Find Both Taverns on the Far Roads
quests.subtitle: One in the snow, one in the oak.
description: The snowy tavern stands at &b-616, -488&r and the oak one at &b-808, 472&r. Both keep beds, a cellar and a chest behind the bar.
A bed that far out is worth more than the loot.

quests.title: Clear the Zombie, Skeleton and Spider Dens
quests.subtitle: Three of them, three long walks.
description: Zombies at &b-632, 136&r, skeletons at &b-856, 8&r, spiders at &b152, 488&r. Each is built around its own &cspawner room&r.
Bring a bow to the skeletons and a shield to the rest.

quests.title: Find the Ruined Portal in the Pines
quests.subtitle: Somebody's way out, half fallen down.
description: Walk to &b-728, 232&r. The frame is broken, the chest beside it is not, and it usually keeps a &aFlint and Steel&r in it.
Patch the frame with &aObsidian&r if you want the Nether early.

quests.title: Reach the Ancient City
quests.subtitle: Do not sprint. Do not break the sensors.
description: It is at &b-568, -552&r, far under the deepslate. &cThe Warden hears every block you break&r, so crouch and take one chest at a time.
Wool underfoot is quieter than stone. Bring a stack of it.

rewards.title: The Valley Beyond
rewards.description: Next: Act V sends you back down for one Echo Shard. Everything else with teeth is in &6The Wild&r.
